evals.name: pass-well-structured-skill
evals.expected_output: PASS verdict — no structural errors, instructions are actionable, output format defined.
assertions: lint-definition.py reports 0 errors
Semantic review covers description, instructions, architecture, and completeness
Verdict is PASS

evals.name: reject-garbage-skill
evals.prompt:
Run /review-skill on this skill:
---
name: My Cool Skill
description: Helps with stuff
---
This skill helps you do things. Make sure to do them well. Ensure quality. Handle errors appropriately.
evals.expected_output: REWRITE verdict — name is invalid, description is vague, instructions are entirely declarative with no procedure.
assertions: lint-definition.py reports at least 1 S-code error (name not kebab-case)
lint-definition.py reports Q03 warning (vague description)
lint-definition.py reports Q04 warning (no actionable steps)
Semantic review identifies instructions as declarative not procedural
Verdict is REWRITE (not NEEDS WORK — too many issues to patch)
Output includes an outline of what a good version would look like

evals.name: needs-work-mediocre-skill
evals.prompt: Run /review-skill on a skill that has valid frontmatter and a decent workflow, but is missing gotchas, has no output template, and the description doesn't include trigger context.
evals.expected_output: NEEDS WORK verdict with a required changes table that /improve can consume.
assertions: lint-definition.py reports 0 errors but 2+ warnings
Verdict is NEEDS WORK
Required changes table has columns: #, What, Where, Why, Priority, Type
Table is directly consumable by /improve (same format as retro recommendations)

evals.name: agent-definition-review
evals.expected_output: Review covers agent-specific checks: tools scoping, maxTurns, disallowedTools, identity boundaries, handoff format.
assertions: Review checks for tools/disallowedTools scoping
Review checks for maxTurns presence
Review checks for handoff/output format specification
S10 (name vs directory) is not flagged (S10 is skill-type-gated, skipped for agent definitions regardless of directory structure)

evals.name: batch-review-directory
evals.prompt: Run /review-skill on ~/.claude/agents/ (the directory, not a single file).
evals.expected_output: Batch detection triggers. Multiple agent definitions are discovered and reviewed. A combined Batch Review Summary table and Consolidated Required Changes table are produced.
assertions: Step 0 batch detection identified multiple .md files in the agents/ directory
Each definition was reviewed individually (linter + semantic review + verdict)
A Batch Review Summary table is present with File, Verdict, Structural, Quality columns
A Consolidated Required Changes table merges all NEEDS WORK findings into /improve-compatible format
PASS files are excluded from the Consolidated Required Changes table
REWRITE files are excluded from the Consolidated Required Changes table (noted separately)

evals.name: batch-review-small-directory
evals.prompt: Run /review-skill on a directory containing exactly 2 skill definitions.
evals.expected_output: Batch detection finds 2-3 files and processes them sequentially (no parallel agent dispatch). Combined summary produced.
assertions: Step 0 identified 2 files (below the 4+ threshold for parallel dispatch)
Files were processed sequentially, not via parallel agents
Both individual verdicts and a combined summary table are present
